text: みずに　ゆられてると　いい　きぶんなの！

structure.jp: みずに　ゆられてると
structure.en: when I'm being rocked by the water

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: みずに　ゆられてる
patterns.explanation: ゆる 'rock' becomes ゆられる 'be rocked', and に shows who does it. みずに　ゆられてる = 'being rocked by the water'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. ゆられてると = 'when I'm being rocked'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの at the end is a soft, girlish way of explaining how things are. いい　きぶんなの = 'it feels good, you see'.
